caption: The shell applies the three redirections in the title before count.sh runs: fd 0 comes from data.txt, fd 1 goes to out.txt and fd 2 to err.txt. The loop writes 3, 7 and 11 to out.txt (7 bytes), err.txt stays empty, and the exit status is 0.

spec.title: ./count.sh < data.txt > out.txt 2> err.txt
spec.aria: The shell opens data.txt as fd 0, out.txt as fd 1 and err.txt as fd 2 before count.sh runs; the read loop takes the lines 1 2, 3 4 and 5 6 from fd 0 and writes the sums 3, 7 and 11 into out.txt, while err.txt stays empty.
